story_type: man in floodwater among submerged cars, rescuer lowered on the cable, hoist into the helicopter
hook: Harvey's flood swallowed these cars. A man was out in it.
narration: Hurricane Harvey's floodwater had buried these cars, and a man was out in it.
This was near Beaumont, Texas, on August thirtieth, 2017.
A Coast Guard helicopter crew came in overhead and sent a rescuer down the cable.
Floodwater hides fences, drains and sunken cars, which is why a lift straight up can be safer than wading out.
[short pause] He held on, and the hoist took them both up.
outcome: The crew pulled him in through the door, out of the flood.
title: Cars underwater, a man in the flood
description:
On Aug. 30, 2017, a Coast Guard air crew conducted a hoist rescue in Hurricane Harvey floodwater near Beaumont, Texas.
